title: Fail-closed repository cleanup despite concurrent branch removals and retired terminal PRs
root_cause: Repository hygiene compares a branch after another janitor deleted it, causing 404. Repository janitor verifies a planned close as closed even when same-run safety reconciliation intentionally reopens the terminal lease. Retired terminal PRs were also eligible for unjustified resurrection.
impact: Scheduled repository cleanup fails and may repeatedly reopen retired PRs; queue and PR clutter remain.
failed_approaches: Re-running failed janitors without correcting compare 404
Marking janitor green despite unexpected readback
Blindly deleting active branch heads to speed cleanup
fix: Only skip missing-branch compare 404 after independent branch 404 readback; accept exact same-run AUTO_REOPEN_TERMINAL_LEASE evidence and independently verify its open/unmerged status; exclude explicit RETIRED candidates from terminal lease reopen.
prevention_rule: Treat inventory as a snapshot. All destructive actions require exact head and open PR protection; a terminal lease reopen is legal only with immutable same-run evidence; retirement must remain terminal.
outcome: CANDIDATE; require exact-head Required test + CodeQL, then protected merge and janitor readback.

shadow: Concurrent branch removal must be confirmed by independent 404; retired PR must not be eligible for reopen
negative_canary: 403 or live branch compare error must fail closed; reopened PR requires same-run evidence and unmerged state
